About ScaleReach

ScaleReach is an AI video repurposing platform that turns long-form video into short vertical clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. You paste a link (YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Google Drive, Dropbox, Loom, Rumble, Dailymotion, Wistia, Vidyard, Streamable or a direct video file) or upload a file, and ScaleReach transcribes it, scores every moment for viral potential, cuts the strongest moments into 9:16 clips with face-tracking reframe and word-by-word captions, then schedules them to your social accounts.

Yes. The free plan gives 100 minutes of video processing with no credit card required. Free clips carry a watermark and editing is limited. Removing the watermark requires a paid plan, which starts at $18/month billed monthly or $12.50/month billed annually.

Three plans. Free is $0 for 100 minutes. Pro is $18/month monthly or $12.50/month annually for 400 minutes/month. Agency is $99/month monthly or $49/month annually for 5,000 minutes/month. Billing counts minutes of source video processed, not clips generated, so Pro on annual billing works out to about $0.03 per source minute.

Two differences that hold across the category. First, price per source minute: about $0.03 on ScaleReach Pro annual against roughly $0.10 on Opus Clip Starter and Vizard. Second, the social scheduler is included at every paid tier, so clipping and publishing happen in one tool instead of two subscriptions. Opus Clip is still stronger on prompt-based clip search and API access.

About ScaleReach

ScaleReach is an AI video repurposing platform that turns long-form video into short vertical clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. You paste a link (YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Google Drive, Dropbox, Loom, Rumble, Dailymotion, Wistia, Vidyard, Streamable or a direct video file) or upload a file, and ScaleReach transcribes it, scores every moment for viral potential, cuts the strongest moments into 9:16 clips with face-tracking reframe and word-by-word captions, then schedules them to your social accounts.

Yes. The free plan gives 100 minutes of video processing with no credit card required. Free clips carry a watermark and editing is limited. Removing the watermark requires a paid plan, which starts at $18/month billed monthly or $12.50/month billed annually.

Three plans. Free is $0 for 100 minutes. Pro is $18/month monthly or $12.50/month annually for 400 minutes/month. Agency is $99/month monthly or $49/month annually for 5,000 minutes/month. Billing counts minutes of source video processed, not clips generated, so Pro on annual billing works out to about $0.03 per source minute.

Two differences that hold across the category. First, price per source minute: about $0.03 on ScaleReach Pro annual against roughly $0.10 on Opus Clip Starter and Vizard. Second, the social scheduler is included at every paid tier, so clipping and publishing happen in one tool instead of two subscriptions. Opus Clip is still stronger on prompt-based clip search and API access.
